 The manager of the company is endowed with the powers to
run and conduct the assets and business of the Company
within the limits of the objects of the Company.
 All powers that are not specifically provided by the law or the
articles of association to be the general meetings shall fall
within the competence of the manager.

 The managing director shall have full powers to manage and
administer assets and activities of the company within the
limit of the company objects. It shall be within his powers to
carry out all those duties which are not expressly reserved for
the general meeting either by law or these articles of
association (Article 15).

Association, the members shall refer to the laws governing
companies in the republic of Rwanda (Article 29).
